$comment: E2E scenario registry: every user-visible behaviour has at least one happy and one bad row. Rules: .agent/skills/quality/e2e_scenario_matrix_skill.md. Row fields are checked by scripts/ci/check_e2e_matrix.py; status is 'planned' until a test tagged @<id> is in the tree, then 'exists'. Test counts appear only in the generated docs/E2E_SCENARIOS.md.

behaviours.name: Embed API (config.js auto-boot, mount, controller, events)

scenarios.title: A static page at the loopback origin renders WebGL2 under SwiftShader
scenarios.asserts: heading and probe canvas visible; a WebGL2 clear reads back rgba(0, 128, 255, 255)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M0. Harness precondition of V02: the e2e tier can render WebGL2 without a GPU (e2e/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A request to a host outside the allowlist is aborted and reported
scenarios.asserts: fetch of api.mapbox.com fails in the page; the firewall fixture records the URL and the console guard the blocked load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M0. Proves the firewall fixture (e2e/support/test.ts) that every later spec relies on to keep real Mapbox and Google off the network.
